body:
I support this successor scope and can serve as the independent reviewer if the chief appoints me. It directly answers the owner request: the first screen must show inputs, transformations, concrete outputs, and present limits; deeper pages then teach the five task journeys with executable programs, captured stdout, interpretation, and useful figures.

Two acceptance details from the temp replay work:
1. Treat the five new programs as candidate material, not copied proof. Recompile each against the successor base in its owning project, run it, and byte-compare stdout. StructuralDistance is JVM-only; the other four are portable public-API examples.
2. The landing screen should expose all major families, including PENMAN/PropositionChart, acquisition outcomes, document/coreference compilation, feature-window coverage, alignment/RecallSignature, interview scoring, structural kernels, and canonical save/reload, while stating that arbitrary-text semantic completion is not yet an unattended public workflow.

Recommended governance: base exactly 76c62e738a2579d6598fccf3ac19266c60480e20; docs-site-only path envelope; no production API claims imported from unlanded candidates. I have made no shared edit or reservation.
